summary.text: Reality Fracture unfolds mostly in Hexhaven's bell tower and the memory-built halls around it, where the Theorist, the last and worst surviving piece of Jace Beleren, plans to lay a new Echoverse over the existing Multiverse.
Tam, the person he made, begins to doubt him, while Vraska, Chandra, Ajani and Garruk arrive to stop him, only to be commanded, overwritten and sent away until Tam helps them.

The stakes are everyone in the original Multiverse, whose souls the overwrite would smother, and the only path left is to gather the scattered pieces of Jace into his body and let it die as the Theorist tries to kill the oracle Jadzi for knowledge he needs.
